name: Claude Trading Skills Marketplace
description: A Claude plugin marketplace packaging tradermonty's claude-trading-skills as 6 themed, installable plugins for Claude Code. Includes 52 trading skills across: Market Analysis (sector rotation, breadth, macro regimes, institutional flows), Stock Screeners (VCP, CANSLIM, PEAD, FinViz, breakout planning), Portfolio & Risk (position sizing, options strategy, scenario analysis), Earnings & Timing (earnings calendar, FTD detection, market top detection), Strategy Tools (backtesting, edge discovery, trade hypothesis), and Dividend Investing (dividend SOPs, US tax accounting, data quality tools). All credit goes to tradermonty; this marketplace repackages the original work into the Claude plugin format for easy discovery and installation.
longDescription:
